meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构查找并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常常要成批改动代码或统一代码风格。
copy.tagline_en: Find code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely refactor code patterns across many files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按代码结构(而非文本)查找或改写代码:先校验查找/替换模式,展示改动预览,确认后才批量修改文件,支持 25 种语言。
howto.when: 当问题依赖代码结构而非文本时触发,如按形状找出某类语法节点(函数、调用等)、批量改写某种写法(例:console.log 改成 logger.info),或应用 YAML 规则。纯文本、注释、文件名等场景交给 rg/grep。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses ast-grep to find or rewrite code by structure rather than text: it validates the search/replace pattern, previews changes, and applies them only after confirmation. Works in 25 languages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the problem depends on code shape, not text: find functions/calls by shape, batch-rewrite patterns, apply YAML rules. Text/comment/filename searches stay with rg/grep.
